'''Vondell''' was a company that was active during the [[Galactic War]]. Among the products they produced were [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]], such as the [[Onyx (landspeeder)|Onyx]] and the [[Ruby (landspeeder)|Ruby]].
